title: Randomness-moli
description: This is just a simple random drop and random enchantment, nothing more.---------随机掉落物和随机附魔仅此而已
body:
CN
基于1.21 Fabric客户端的随机掉落物并且会随机获得附魔 有概率获得666级附魔哦------------------------------------EN
Randomized Drops & Enchantments
Randomized item drops for Fabric 1.21. Every item comes with random enchantments, with a rare chance to obtain Level 666 enchants!
